subject.title: fix: prevent session exports from writing outside workspace

question: Should full session exports be restricted to configured command owners, matching trajectory export and other dangerous commands?
rationale: Workspace confinement is required to fix the vulnerability, but revoking existing helper access is an intentional security and compatibility policy choice that automation should not make.

options.title: Approve owner-only exports
options.body: Merge the current defense-in-depth patch and document that authorized non-owner helpers can no longer export full sessions.

options.title: Preserve helper access separately
options.body: Keep full exports owner-only but design a distinct sanitized export capability later if helpers need a supported workflow.

recommendation.title: Approve owner-only exports
recommendation.body: Merge the current defense-in-depth patch and document that authorized non-owner helpers can no longer export full sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: The original feature was committed through Peter, and recent affected-module history makes him the best available owner for confirming the product security boundary.
